findings.body:
**Send Oxlint narration to stderr.**

If Oxlint writes a summary or diagnostics to stdout, Line 89 forwards that text to the runner’s stdout. This breaks the stderr-only narration contract stated at `scripts/ratchet-typecheck.mjs:3-5`. Forward Oxlint’s output to stderr instead. As per coding guidelines, “stdout is JSON, stderr is narration.”
findings.title: Send Oxlint narration to stderr.

findings.body:
**Use `tsc6` for the ratchet check.**

Line 34 calls `runTypecheckRaw`, which executes `node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc` in `scripts/ratchet-lib.mjs:332-356`. The ratchet can therefore measure diagnostics from a compiler other than the required `tsc6`. Change the helper to invoke `tsc6` before using its output as baseline evidence. As per path instructions, “The typecheck ratchet invokes tsc6, never tsc (the bare name is alias-owned).”
findings.title: Use `tsc6` for the ratchet check.

findings.body:
**Clarify the `ratchet.yml` status.**

This row says the required workflow is retired. `policy/DOCTRINE.md` describes it as required and active (Lines 105–106 and 130–134), and this guide later lists its template as instantiated (Lines 145–147). Distinguish the retired head-defined behavior from the active workflow so adopters do not remove the required check.
findings.title: Clarify the `ratchet.yml` status.

findings.body:
**Align the I3 enforcement text with the direct-main path.**

`policy/DOCTRINE.md:65-73` says an active gate, `policy/templates/gate.yml` instantiated as `.github/workflows/gate.yml`, performs one atomic leased push to `main`, `cq/promoted`, and `merge-queue`. No such gate exists in the inspected tree, and that enforcement is not active. Replace the text with the controls that apply today.

Do not wire `gitPushAtomic` into a gate. The live settings retire `cq-r2-merge-queue` and delete the `merge-queue` and `cq/promoted` branches. A three-ref push would recreate retired refs.

Apply the same correction to the I3 section of `policy/templates/README.md`. That section describes `cq-gate` as armed and "the ONLY component that advances main." It also describes promotion as an atomic leased push, and its "Entitlement facts" text depends on that mechanism. Remove those statements. Also revise the I3 Rule's "`main` is advanced by the gate alone" to match the direct-main path.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix for policy/DOCTRINE.md</summary>

```diff
-**Enforcement (today).** `policy/templates/gate.yml`, instantiated as
-`.github/workflows/gate.yml` (armed — `CQ_GATE_PROMOTES: 'true'`), is the only component that advances
-`main`, behind merge-base guards: an already-contained queue tip is a logged
-no-op; divergence refuses and a human merges `main` into `merge-queue`.
-After subject selection and all admission checks, the CLI uses one atomic leased
-push with three refspecs: `<subject>:refs/heads/main`,
-`<subject>:refs/heads/cq/promoted`, and `<tip>:refs/heads/merge-queue`.
-`main` advances only by fast-forward; the queue ref retains the observed tip.
-Each ref must still equal its leased value; rejection prevents every update.
+**Enforcement (today).** No promotion workflow advances `main`. The `cq-r0-history` ruleset in
+`policy/templates/github-settings.json` rejects non-fast-forward updates and deletion of `main`.
+The `cq-r1-main` ruleset requires a pull request, and allows only the merge-commit merge method.
```

</details>
findings.title: Align the I3 enforcement text with the direct-main path.
